name: vibedev_rail_reply_no_project
content: I can't start a build: this workspace has no VibeDev project to build into.

`@vibedev` only ever *finds* a project — it will not create one, because putting a repo somewhere you did not choose is worse than refusing. Open the VibeDev cockpit, create or pick a project there, then come back and try `@vibedev` again.

metadata.description: Assistant reply when a `@vibedev` chat turn resolves to no VibeDev project. No task is created. Deliberately does not offer to create one: project creation is a cockpit act, and a silently-minted repo is the failure this refusal exists to prevent.
metadata.author: magician
